comp_1.name: Line Supervisor
comp_1.description: Starts the production line by calling the first stage, Cut, and reports the result.
comp_1.script:
import perceivo
from perceivo.primitives import AgentInput, AgentOutput, Artifact, ArtifactType


@perceivo.agent
async def line_supervisor(input: AgentInput) -> AgentOutput:
    """Call the first stage and wait while the whole line runs."""
    product = input.request_data["product"]
    seconds = input.request_data["seconds_per_stage"]

    perceivo.log.info("Line Supervisor: starting the line", product=product)

    # Cut calls Weld, Weld calls Paint, Paint calls Inspection. This one call
    # returns when Inspection has finished and every stage has handed back.
    result = await perceivo.flow.invoke(
        "first_stage",
        request_data={"product": product, "seconds": seconds, "traveler": ""},
    )
    traveler = result["response_data"]["traveler"]
    passed = result["response_data"]["passed"]
    stages_completed = len(traveler.strip().splitlines())

    perceivo.log.info("Line Supervisor: line finished", stages_completed=stages_completed, passed=passed)

    return AgentOutput(
        artifact=Artifact(type=ArtifactType.TEXT, data=f"{product}\n{traveler}"),
        response_data={"product": product, "stages_completed": stages_completed, "passed": passed},
    )

comp_2.name: Cut
comp_2.description: Stage 1 of the production line. Cuts the parts, then calls Weld.
comp_2.script:
import asyncio

import perceivo
from perceivo.primitives import ToolInput, ToolOutput


@perceivo.tool
async def cut(input: ToolInput) -> ToolOutput:
    """Stage 1: cutting the parts, then hand the work order to Weld."""
    product = input.request_data["product"]
    seconds = input.request_data["seconds"]
    traveler = input.request_data["traveler"]

    perceivo.log.info("Cut: cutting the parts", product=product, seconds=seconds)
    await asyncio.sleep(seconds)
    traveler = traveler + "Cut: done\n"

    # Call the next stage through this tool's own tool port, and wait for it.
    result = await perceivo.flow.invoke(
        "next_stage",
        request_data={"product": product, "seconds": seconds, "traveler": traveler},
    )
    # Pass the next stage's answer back up the line, field by field.
    answer = result["response_data"]
    return ToolOutput(response_data={"traveler": answer["traveler"], "passed": answer["passed"]})

comp_5.name: Inspection
comp_5.description: Stage 4 of the production line. Inspects the finished product, then returns the result.
comp_5.script:
import asyncio

import perceivo
from perceivo.primitives import ToolInput, ToolOutput


@perceivo.tool
async def inspection(input: ToolInput) -> ToolOutput:
    """Stage 4: inspecting the finished product. This is the last stage, so it returns the result."""
    product = input.request_data["product"]
    seconds = input.request_data["seconds"]
    traveler = input.request_data["traveler"]

    perceivo.log.info("Inspection: inspecting the finished product", product=product, seconds=seconds)
    await asyncio.sleep(seconds)
    traveler = traveler + "Inspection: passed\n"

    return ToolOutput(response_data={"traveler": traveler, "passed": True})
